standout_why: This score is provisional, because no rival page was read. The Attack Shark X65 Pro HE and X68 Pro HE pages (attackshark.com), the AULA Hero75 HE page (aulatechstore.com) and the manuals.plus X68PRO HE manual all failed to open (HTTP 429, a connection error from the store tool, and an image-only PDF). The only rival content I can compare against is ChatGPT's own answer in the brief, which already says the X65 Pro HE and X68 Pro HE drop from 8,000 Hz wired to 1,000 Hz wireless. A report interval is one division away from that (1,000 ÷ 8,000 = 0.125 ms; 1,000 ÷ 1,000 = 1 ms), so rivals effectively hold part of this angle's best figure. I could not check whether any rival states battery hours in wireless mode or a measured wireless latency.
decides: Nothing is decided on sourced evidence from this angle today. The derivation the page would want is the report interval per mode for each board. If the Dealectric record for the Gamakay TK75 TMR holds (8,000 Hz wired and 2.4 GHz, 1,000 Hz Bluetooth, credited to HLPlanet in the brief; not opened by me), its dongle interval is 0.125 ms. ChatGPT's answer puts the Attack Shark X68 Pro HE at 1,000 Hz wireless, which is 1 ms, so the TK75 TMR would send 8 reports for each one of the X68 Pro HE's. That would favour the TK75 TMR as the linked pick for rapid trigger on a dongle. Both inputs need to be re-read at the maker pages before the page uses them.

Named-reviewer measurements for the Gamakay TK75HE V2 (wireless latency in ms, battery drain over a stated period). The TechRadar and PC Gamer reviews returned only navigation text at three offsets; AppleInsider and the inkl.com copy of the TechRadar review returned HTTP 403.
